title: Lex-Cybernetica Version 2.0: Provisional Legal Framework for Cybernetic Integration, Future Persons and Synthetic Society
description: Lex-Cybernetica Version 2.0 is a provisional legal and philosophical framework for cybernetic integration, future persons and synthetic society. It consolidates 72 working-doctrine provisions covering personhood, SII, Essential Functions, Material Control, Right to Analog, identity and continuity, Genesis and reproduction, parentage, sex/gender/reproductive configuration, embodiment, forks and successor persons, cognitive rights, evidence, criminal/corporate responsibility, jurisdiction and institutional safeguards. It is a consultation draft, not enacted law.
